turns.speaker: Receptionist
turns.text: Good morning, City Language Centre. How can I help you today?

turns.speaker: Student
turns.text: Hi, I'd like to ask about the evening English courses. What levels do you offer?

turns.speaker: Receptionist
turns.text: We run three levels. The upper-intermediate class meets on Tuesdays and Thursdays, from six thirty to eight thirty.

turns.speaker: Student
turns.text: That sounds good. My name is Carlos Rivera, and my surname is spelled R-I-V-E-R-A.
